title: Assistant drafts
summary: Drafts that the user's own assistant wrote through bipe-mcp (draft_message). A banner above the composer in the target chat, and a list of all drafts. The user edits, sends or discards each one. Nothing is sent until the user taps Send (ADR 0210).

eventId.description: The draft message in the drafts room.

roomId.description: The target chat, from the chat.bipe.draft field.

body.description: The draft text (body of the m.text message).

replyTo.description: Event the sent message replies to.

threadRoot.description: Thread the sent message goes into.

client.description: Name of the MCP client that wrote the draft, for example Claude Desktop.

draftsRoomId.description: room_id of the global account data chat.bipe.drafts_room. Absent: no drafts room yet, so no drafts.

drafts.description: Every message of the drafts room that draftFromEvent shows (test-vectors/drafts.json), newest first.

currentRoomDrafts.description: The drafts whose roomId is the open chat. The banner shows the newest; a count shows when there are more.

sending.description: A send is in progress. Send and Discard are off.

failed.description: The last send failed: bipe_app_drafts_send_failed. The draft stays.

appear.effect: Client.accountData for chat.bipe.drafts_room. With a room ID: Client.getRoom, then the room timeline. Each item's raw event (LazyTimelineItemProvider.debugInfo originalJson) goes through draftFromEvent with the user's own ID and the joined rooms; the shown ones fill drafts. The list updates live from the timeline.

openDraft.effect: From the list: opens the target chat with that draft in the banner.

edit.effect: Puts body in the composer of the target chat (with message-reply for replyTo), then redacts the draft. The text is now the user's own composer draft.

send.effect: Sends body in the target chat as the user's own message, as a reply to replyTo and in threadRoot when present, with no AI marker (ADR 0210). After the send succeeds, Timeline.redactEvent on the draft in the drafts room. On failure: failed, and the draft stays.

discard.effect: Timeline.redactEvent on the draft. It disappears on every device of the user.

openList.effect: Opens the list of all drafts (from the chat list menu, shown only when drafts is not empty).

notes: Protocol: bipe-shared docs/drafts-room.md. Names: registries/drafts.json. Rules: test-vectors/drafts.json (draftFromEvent).
The drafts room never shows in the chat list, search, share targets, forward targets or the unread count. Hide it by the room ID in chat.bipe.drafts_room.

The apps never create the drafts room just to read. The writer (bipe-mcp) creates it on the first draft_message: Client.createRoom, encrypted, private, no invites, name bipe_app_drafts_title, then Client.setAccountData chat.bipe.drafts_room. When the account data already has a room, every device uses it and never makes a second one.
A draft from another account, for a room the user is not in, or longer than bodyMaxLength is never shown (draftFromEvent).
bipe_app_drafts_nothing_sent shows under the banner the first time a draft appears on a device.
Out of scope now: syncing the user's own composer drafts between devices through this room (ADR 0210 consequences).
